import pandas as pd
pd.set_option("display.width", 220)
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", 40)

N, QUORUM = 5, 3
canonical, DELAYS = [], []

class Node:
    def __init__(self, rid):
        self.rid = rid; self.up = True; self.group = 1; self.epoch = 0
        self.role = "follower"; self.leader = None
        self.log = []; self.commit_index = 0; self.applied_index = 0
    @property
    def last_index(self): return len(self.log)

nodes = {f"r{i}": Node(f"r{i}") for i in range(N)}

def set_delay(a, b, ms, until): DELAYS.append((a, b, ms, until))

def delay_between(a, b, t):
    d = 0
    for fa, fb, ms, until in DELAYS:
        if fa == a and fb == b and t <= until: d = max(d, ms)
    return d

def can_talk(a, b):
    return nodes[a].up and nodes[b].up and nodes[a].group == nodes[b].group

def leader_in_group(g):
    for rid, n in nodes.items():
        if n.up and n.group == g and n.role == "leader": return rid
    return None

def elect(cand_id, epoch):
    c = nodes[cand_id]
    if not c.up: return None, []
    c.epoch = epoch; votes = [cand_id]
    for rid, n in nodes.items():
        if rid == cand_id or not n.up or n.group != c.group: continue
        if n.epoch <= epoch: n.epoch = epoch; votes.append(rid)
    if len(votes) >= QUORUM:
        for rid, n in nodes.items():
            if n.up and n.group == c.group: n.role = "follower"; n.leader = cand_id
        c.role = "leader"; return cand_id, votes
    return None, votes

def write(value, t, via=None):
    """Client submit at logical time t; `via` = node the client is attached to."""
    if via is None:                                  # attach to any current leader
        lid = leader_in_group(nodes["r0"].group)
        via = lid if lid else "r0"
    g = nodes[via].group
    lid = leader_in_group(g)
    if lid is None:
        return dict(t=t, value=value, via=via, status="REFUSED:no-leader", acks=0,
                    commit_t=None, latency_ms=None)
    L = nodes[lid]
    entry = dict(index=L.last_index + 1, value=value, epoch=L.epoch, leader=lid)
    L.log.append(entry)
    ack_times = {lid: t}
    for rid, n in nodes.items():
        if rid == lid or not can_talk(lid, rid): continue
        recv = t + delay_between(lid, rid, t)        # delayed message lands late
        n.log.append(dict(entry)); ack_times[rid] = recv
    if len(ack_times) >= QUORUM:
        ctime = sorted(ack_times.values())[QUORUM - 1]
        for rid in ack_times: nodes[rid].commit_index = entry["index"]
        canonical.append(entry)
        return dict(t=t, value=value, via=via, status="committed", acks=len(ack_times),
                    commit_t=ctime, latency_ms=ctime - t)
    return dict(t=t, value=value, via=via, status="REFUSED:no-quorum", acks=len(ack_times),
                commit_t=None, latency_ms=None)

def sync(rid):
    n = nodes[rid]
    for e in canonical:
        if e["index"] > n.last_index: n.log.append(dict(e))
        elif n.log[e["index"] - 1] != e:
            n.log = n.log[:e["index"] - 1]; n.log.append(dict(e))
    n.commit_index = len(canonical)

att = []      # write attempts
state = []    # state timeline
def snap(t, phase, note=""):
    consistent = all(n.log[i]["value"] == e["value"]
                     for n in nodes.values() for i, e in enumerate(canonical) if i < n.last_index
                     ) and all(n.commit_index <= n.last_index for n in nodes.values())
    state.append(dict(t=t, phase=phase, epoch=max(n.epoch for n in nodes.values()),
                      leader=leader_in_group(1) or leader_in_group(2),
                      up=sum(n.up for n in nodes.values()),
                      g1=sum(1 for n in nodes.values() if n.up and n.group == 1),
                      g2=sum(1 for n in nodes.values() if n.up and n.group == 2),
                      canonical=len(canonical), commit_index=len(canonical),
                      consistent=consistent, note=note))

# ---------------- FAULT SCHEDULE (deterministic, exact times) ----------------
SCHEDULE = pd.DataFrame([
    (300,  "leader crash",      "r0 (leader)",              "r0 stops; no leader until election"),
    (400,  "election",          "r3",                       "r3 wins epoch 2, quorum 4/5"),
    (550,  "delayed message",   "r3 -> r1",                 "append_entries + ack delayed 150 ms"),
    (550,  "follower crash",    "r4",                       "r4 stops"),
    (750,  "recover",           "r0, r4",                   "both rejoin and resync"),
    (800,  "network partition", "{r1,r3,r4} | {r0,r2}",     "3|2 split, majority keeps quorum"),
    (950,  "heal",              "all",                      "partition healed, groups merge"),
], columns=["t_ms", "fault", "affected_nodes", "detail"])

# ---------------- run ----------------
elect("r0", 1)
att.append(write("w1", 100)); att.append(write("w2", 200))
snap(250, "steady", "leader r0")

nodes["r0"].up = False; nodes["r0"].role = "follower"     # LEADER CRASH
snap(300, "leader-crash", "r0 down")
att.append(write("w3", 320))
att.append(write("w4", 350))
snap(360, "no-leader", "election pending")

elect("r3", 2); snap(410, "re-elected", "r3 leader, epoch 2")
att.append(write("w5", 450))

nodes["r4"].up = False                                    # follower crash + DELAY
set_delay("r3", "r1", 150, 720)
w6 = write("w6", 550); att.append(w6)
snap(600, "delayed-ack-pending", "w6 not yet committed")

nodes["r0"].up = True; nodes["r4"].up = True
sync("r0"); sync("r4"); snap(760, "resynced", "r0/r4 caught up")

for n in nodes.values(): n.group = 1                       # PARTITION
for rid in ("r1", "r3", "r4"): nodes[rid].group = 1
for rid in ("r0", "r2"):       nodes[rid].group = 2
snap(800, "partition", "G1={r1,r3,r4} G2={r0,r2}")

att.append(write("w7", 850, via="r3"))                     # majority side: OK
att.append(write("w8", 880, via="r0"))                     # minority side: fails
att.append(write("w9", 900, via="r2"))                     # minority side: fails
snap(910, "partition-active", "minority cannot commit")

for n in nodes.values(): n.group = 1                       # HEAL
for rid in nodes: sync(rid)
snap(950, "healed", "groups merged")
att.append(write("w10", 1000))
snap(1010, "final", "all converged")

att_df = pd.DataFrame(att)
print("=== DETERMINISTIC FAULT SCHEDULE ===")
display(SCHEDULE)
print("\n=== WRITE ATTEMPTS (client operations) ===")
display(att_df)
print("\n=== STATE TIMELINE ===")
display(pd.DataFrame(state))

ok = att_df.status.eq("committed").sum()
print(f"\nwrites attempted = {len(att_df)}, committed = {ok}, refused = {len(att_df) - ok}")
print(f"AVAILABILITY (write success rate) = {ok/len(att_df):.0%}")
print(f"CONSISTENCY (no committed-prefix divergence): "
      f"{all(s['consistent'] for s in state)}")
print(f"delayed write w6: commit_t={w6['commit_t']} vs submit t=550 "
      f"-> +{w6['latency_ms']} ms")
